figurative_meaning_en: Gone bad or spoiled; annoyed, unfavorable
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মেজাজ খাট্টা হয়ে গেছে আজকাল।
এই খবর শুনে আমার মন খাট্টা হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: His mood has turned sour lately.
Hearing this news made my mind sour.
note: Commonly used in the phrase 'মেজাজ খাট্টা' to describe a bad or irritable mood, drawing from the literal sense of sourness in food.
